description: A woman in a red coat sits alone in a dim train carriage at night, close-up portrait with soft window light.

spec.subject: Woman, late 20s to early 30s, slim build, shoulder-length dark hair tucked behind one ear, wearing a wool red coat with a high collar over a dark top; no visible jewelry, natural makeup, calm but tired expression.
spec.setting: Interior of a dim passenger train carriage at night; only the seat back, a narrow slice of window edge, and the blurred dark exterior reflections are visible in frame.
spec.action: Sitting still alone, gaze lowered slightly toward the window just out of frame.
spec.camera_angle: front three-quarter view from slightly above eye level, extreme close-up portrait, 85mm lens, woman placed slightly off-center with her face filling most of the frame.
spec.lighting: Soft cool window light from camera-left, wrapping gently across her face; very low ambient carriage light with no strong practicals visible; low contrast, blue-gray night tones with the red coat providing the main color accent.
spec.style: Digital handheld-look portrait texture with fine grain, subdued contrast, muted night palette; restrained naturalistic lighting with soft falloff and shallow depth of field.
